tooltips.name: Only master entities that already have a derivative with the Contributor role can be selected.
tooltips.consolidationScript: Configure how source data is transformed, unified, and mapped to the master record. The script must return a JSON object with the field values of the master record.
tooltips.executeConsolidationAs: The user account that will be used to execute the Consolidation Script.
tooltips.skipCondition: An ExpressionLanguage expression evaluated for each candidate with access to `candidate` and `masterRecord` (empty while the master record is not created yet). Candidates for which it returns true are excluded from `candidates` of the consolidation script. If no candidates remain, the master record is neither created nor updated - e.g. candidate.get('name') == null.

exceptions.consolidationScriptIsMissing: Consolidation script is missing for master entity
exceptions.entityTypeInvalid: Entity type "%s" cannot be used for consolidation
